title: Introduction
description:
Welcome to a new land, a peaceful land. A land of rolling green pastures, deep forests, and flower-filled meadows. A land of possibility. A land where the swords were beaten to plowshares so long ago that no one can even remember that there were ever swords at all.

Welcome to Seed & Stock.

How to Use this Book:

While this book does provide quests, they are primarly focused on introducing you to this pack's basic mechanics. Everything is optional, and no Quest provides any reward beyond the satisfaction of completing it.
